xc_files.name: buzzers.xc
RGB.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
storage var $r : number
storage var $g : number
storage var $b : number
storage var $phase : number

init
	$r = 255
	$g = 0
	$b = 0
	$phase = 0
function@rgb()
	if $phase == 0
		$g++
		if $g >= 255
			$g = 255
			$phase = 1
	elseif $phase == 1
		$r--
		if $r <= 0
			$r = 0
			$phase = 2
	elseif $phase == 2
		$b++
		if $b >= 255
			$b = 255
			$phase = 3
	elseif $phase == 3 
		$g--
		if $g <= 0
			$g = 0
			$phase = 4
	elseif $phase == 4
		$r++
		if $r >= 255
			$r = 255
			$phase = 5
	elseif $phase == 5 
		$b--
		if $b <= 0
			$b = 0
			$phase = 0
	
	print($r, $g, $b)
tick
	
	var $s = screen("rgbpanel", 1)
	
	var $s1 = screen("rgb_p1", 0)
	var $s2 = screen("rgb_p2", 0)
	var $s3 = screen("rgb_p3", 0)
	var $s4 = screen("rgb_p4", 0)
	var $s5 = screen("rgb_p5", 0)
	var $s6 = screen("rgb_p6", 0)
	
	
	
	
	if input_number("rgbpanel", 3) == 1
		var $rgbcolor = color($r, $g, $b)
		@rgb()
		;0
		$s.blank()
		$s.draw_rect(0,0,60,180,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;1
		$s1.blank()
		$s1.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;2
		$s2.blank()
		$s2.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;3
		$s3.blank()
		$s3.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;4
		$s4.blank()
		$s4.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;5
		$s5.blank()
		$s5.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
		;6
		$s6.blank()
		$s6.draw_rect(0,0,1000,1000,$rgbcolor,$rgbcolor)
